explore.label: I'll explore myself
explore.hint: Stop automatic tours. Getting started stays in the menu.

never.label: Never show tips
never.hint: Turn them back on in Settings

tips.title: Tips and tours
tips.description: Short guided tours that show up as you use TMGR.
tips.saveFailed: Could not save your choice. Please try again.

auto.label: Show tips automatically
auto.description: A short tour is offered the first time you open a feature.

hubOnly.label: Only from Getting started
hubOnly.description: No automatic tours. Start any tour yourself from the Getting started page.

off.label: Never show tips
off.description: Tours stay on the Getting started page if you want them.

hints.notOpen: You are on the right page, but this part is not open yet. Open it, or skip this step.
hints.notFound: We could not find this on the screen right now.
hints.timerTooShort: Let the timer run for at least a minute.

hub.askOwnerModule: Ask the workspace owner to turn on {label}

workLog.title: Watch an agent log its work

s1.title: Agent runs
s1.body: Your agent's runs appear here: branch, commits, tests and time.

s2.title: Run in progress
s2.body: Waiting for the agent to finish its run…

s3.title: Agent time
s3.body: Agent time never adds to your tracked time. You see both.

s1.title: Create a notify token
s1.body: Create a notify token so your agent can ping your phone.

s2.title: Add it to your agent
s2.body: Add npx -y {'@'}tmgr/notify mcp to your agent, then send a test.

s3.title: Send a test
s3.body: iPhone (TestFlight beta) rings through Silent mode on iOS 26 or later.

s1.title: Create a token
s1.body: This token lets any MCP client act as you. Shown once, stored hashed.

s1.title: Open Ask AI
s1.body: Ask questions about tasks, time and deadlines.
s1.mobileBody: Tap Ask AI in the top bar.

s2.title: Ask a question
s2.body: Try: what did I work on this week?

s1.title: Pick your client
s1.body: Pick the client you use. Each tab shows its own command.

s2.title: Copy the command
s2.body: Copy this command and run it in your terminal. The token is shown once.
s2.mobileBody: Open this page on your computer, or copy the command to send it there.

s3.title: Waiting for your agent
s3.body: Waiting for your agent to connect. This updates by itself.

s4.title: Try a prompt
s4.body: Paste this prompt into your agent. It will pick up the starter task.

s1.title: Quick add
s1.body: Press {'{'}key:quickAdd{'}'} in any app. A small capture window opens.

s2.title: Capture something
s2.body: Type a title and press Enter. It joins your daily routine, or becomes a board task if it has a screenshot.

s1.title: Capture shortcuts
s1.body: {'{'}key:screenshot{'}'} turns a screenshot into a task. {'{'}key:selection{'}'} turns selected text into one.
s1.bodyMacos: {'{'}key:screenshot{'}'} turns a screenshot into a task. {'{'}key:selection{'}'} turns selected text into one.
s1.bodyOther: {'{'}key:screenshot{'}'} turns a screenshot into a task.

s2.title: Change a shortcut
s2.body: Change any shortcut here.

menuBarTimer.title: Timer in the menu bar or tray

s1.title: Your running timer
s1.body: Your running timer lives in the menu bar. Stop or switch it without opening TMGR.
s1.bodyMacos: Your running timer lives in the menu bar. Stop or switch it without opening TMGR.
s1.bodyOther: Your running timer is in the TMGR menu in the system tray. Stop or switch it there.

s2.title: Closing the window
s2.body: Closing the window keeps TMGR running in the menu bar.
s2.bodyMacos: Closing the window keeps TMGR running in the menu bar.
s2.bodyOther: Closing the window keeps TMGR running in the system tray.

s1.title: Own window
s1.body: Open a task or page in its own window. It stays in sync.

s1.title: Stored on this computer
s1.body: This workspace is stored on this computer. Its tasks and pages stay here unless you move them to the cloud.

s2.title: Local badge
s2.body: Local workspaces show this badge. Cloud ones do not.

s3.title: Create an account
s3.body: Create an account later to use TMGR on other devices.
s3.mobileBody: Open the menu to create an account later and use TMGR on other devices.

s1.title: Automatic backups
s1.body: TMGR backs up local workspaces daily. It keeps 7 daily, 4 weekly and 3 monthly copies.

s2.title: Back up now
s2.body: Back up now before big changes.

s1.title: Connect your agent
s1.body: Agents on this computer can work in local workspaces. Tick yours and press Install. TMGR sets up the connection and turns on what it needs.

s2.title: Connect your agent
s2.body: Pick your agent and press Install. We continue on its first call.

s1.title: Install a plugin
s1.body: Install a plugin from a GitHub URL. Plugins run in a sandbox with declared permissions.

s2.title: Permissions
s2.body: Help explains each permission before you grant it.

s1.title: New in this version
s1.body: New in this version. Take a one-minute tour.

moveToCloud.title: Move a local workspace to your account

s1.title: Move to cloud
s1.body: Copy this local workspace into your cloud account. Your local copy stays.

s2.title: Copying
s2.body: Copying your workspace. This can take a minute.

s1.title: A demo agent at work
s1.body: We open a demo workspace where a simulated agent fixes a bug. Nothing runs on your Mac.

s2.title: Watch the board
s2.body: The card moves, the timer ticks and the run fills in. Press Esc to skip ahead.

s1.title: The map
s1.body: Tasks, pages and people as a map. Lines are links, relations and mentions.

s2.title: Filters
s2.body: Filter by type or category to see one corner of the workspace.

s3.title: Search
s3.body: Search, or click any node to open it.

s1.title: Switch Graph on
s1.body: Graph is off in this workspace. Switch it on to see the map.

s1.title: Create a page
s1.body: Create a page. Markdown, images and files are welcome.

s2.title: Page tree
s2.body: Pinned and recent pages are in your sidebar. All pages shows the whole tree: drag pages to nest them.

s1.title: Create a context page
s1.body: Choose the context page type. Agents read it before they work.

s2.title: Write the context
s2.body: Write what every agent should know: stack, conventions, where things live.

s1.title: Add a link
s1.body: Type {'@'} or [[ to link a task, page, category or person.

s2.title: Backlinks
s2.body: Backlinks show every page that mentions this one.

s1.title: Versions
s1.body: Open a page, then History. Every save is a version you can compare and restore.

s1.title: Page types
s1.body: Make a person page (role, company, open tasks) or a meeting page (date, participants).

s1.title: Import
s1.body: Import .md files or a .zip: an Obsidian vault or a Notion export.

s2.title: Export
s2.body: Export a page as .md, or the whole tree as .zip.

s1.title: Make a task
s1.body: Select text, then Make a task. The task links back to this page.

s1.title: Create a persona
s1.body: Create a persona: a name, a system prompt and skills for one agent.

s2.title: Workspace access
s2.body: Grant it workspaces and permissions: allowed, read only or forbidden.

s1.title: Create a token
s1.body: Create a token for this persona. Valid 1 to 365 days, shown once.

assign.title: Assign a task to a persona

s1.title: Assign the task
s1.body: Assign this task to your persona. It shows up in the agent's queue.

s2.title: The agent picks it up
s2.body: The agent reads its queue with list_my_queue and picks the task up.

s1.title: Skills
s1.body: Skills are reusable instructions the agent loads when it needs them.

s1.title: Add a routine
s1.body: Add something you repeat: daily, weekly, monthly or yearly.

s2.title: Tick it off
s2.body: Tick it off for today.

s1.title: Views
s1.body: Switch views. The year view is a heatmap of what you kept up.

s1.title: Open a routine
s1.body: Open a routine to edit it. Add one first if the list is empty.

s2.title: Reminder
s2.body: Set a reminder before a routine is due.

s3.title: Convert to a task
s3.body: Turn a routine into a task when it grows.

s1.title: Your workspace
s1.body: This is your workspace. List, Board, Routines and Pages live here.
s1.mobileBody: Tap the menu to switch between List, Board, Routines and Pages.

s2.title: Workspaces
s2.body: Switch workspaces or create a new one here.
s2.mobileBody: Open the menu to switch workspaces or create a new one.

s3.title: New task
s3.body: Create a task from anywhere with this button.

s4.title: Your menu
s4.body: Your profile, Settings and light or dark mode are in your menu.
s4.mobileBody: Open the menu for your profile, Settings and light or dark mode.

s5.title: Getting started
s5.body: Tours and your checklist wait here. Come back any time.
s5.mobileBody: Tours and your checklist are in the menu. Come back any time.

s1.title: Create a task
s1.body: Click here to create a task.
s1.mobileBody: Tap here to create a task.

s2.title: Give it a title
s2.body: Type a title, then press Create or Ctrl+S. Everything else is optional.
s2.mobileBody: Type a title, then tap Create. Everything else is optional.

s3.title: Your first task
s3.body: Done. Click a task to open details, a timer and comments.
s3.mobileBody: Done. Tap a task to open details, a timer and comments.

s1.title: Checklist
s1.body: Your checklist ticks itself as you go.

s2.title: Tours
s2.body: Short tours for every feature. Do them in any order.

s3.title: Automatic tips
s3.body: Turn automatic tips off here. Tours stay available on this page.

s1.title: Pick your client
s1.body: Pick the client you use. Each tab shows its own command.

s2.title: Copy the command
s2.body: Copy this command and run it in your terminal. The token is shown once.
s2.mobileBody: Open this page on your computer, or copy the command to send it there.

s3.title: Waiting for your agent
s3.body: Waiting for your agent to connect. This updates by itself.

s4.title: Try a prompt
s4.body: Paste this prompt into your agent. It will pick up the starter task.

s1.title: Status
s1.body: Status moves the task across your board.

s2.title: Category
s2.body: Categories give tasks ticket codes: a short prefix plus a number.

s3.title: Assignees
s3.body: Assign people or personas. Personas are your AI agents.

s4.title: Description
s4.body: Write details here. Agents read this too.

s5.title: Done
s5.body: Tick to complete. Completed tasks move to the archive.

boardMove.title: Move a card on the board

s1.title: Columns
s1.body: Each column is a status.

s2.title: Move a card
s2.body: Drag this card by its handle to In progress. Or open it and change Status.
s2.mobileBody: Open a card and change its Status. No dragging needed.

s3.title: Add to a column
s3.body: Add a task straight into a column here.

s1.title: Comments
s1.body: Leave a comment. Agents post their notes here too.

s2.title: Files
s2.body: Attach files up to 25 MB, or paste an image.

s1.title: Archive
s1.body: Completed tasks are kept here. Open the archive to find them again.
s1.mobileBody: Open the menu to find the archive, where completed tasks are kept.

s1.title: Statuses
s1.body: Rename, colour and reorder statuses. The type decides what counts as active or done.

s2.title: Add a status
s2.body: Add a status for your own stage, for example Review.

s1.title: Create a category
s1.body: Create a category. Its short code becomes the prefix of every task number in it.
s1.mobileBody: Open the menu and tap + next to Categories. The short code becomes the prefix of every task number in it.

s2.title: Open a category
s2.body: Open a category to see only its tasks. Categories can nest.
s2.mobileBody: Your categories live in the menu. Open one to see only its tasks.

s1.title: Relations
s1.body: Mark that this task blocks, duplicates or relates to another one.

s1.title: Files
s1.body: Every file attached to a task or page in this workspace.

s1.title: Selection mode
s1.body: Select several tasks to move, complete or export them together.

s1.title: Start the timer
s1.body: Press play. We'll move on as soon as it is running.

s2.title: Running timers
s2.body: Running timers stay visible here, even when the task is closed.

s3.title: Stop the timer
s3.body: Stop it when you're done. Time adds to the task.

s4.title: Estimates
s4.body: Set an estimate in task settings to see when you run over.

s1.title: Several timers at once
s1.body: Start a timer on each task you work on. Every running timer is collected in one badge.

s2.title: Running timers
s2.body: Stop or switch your running timers here.

s1.title: Log a checkpoint
s1.body: Log a checkpoint: a titled slice of time inside this task.

s1.title: Turn on Pomodoro
s1.body: Turn on Pomodoro for this task. Focus and breaks sync to iPhone and Watch.

s2.title: Pomodoro settings
s2.body: Change lengths, auto-start and whether breaks pause tracked time.

s1.title: Select tasks
s1.body: Select the tasks to export.

s2.title: Open actions
s2.body: Open the actions for the selected tasks.

s3.title: Export settings
s3.body: Choose rounding, weekend days and holidays for the report.

s4.title: Download
s4.body: Download XLSX, CSV or an image (JPEG).

s1.title: Presets
s1.body: Start from a preset: personal, developer, team or everything.

s2.title: Modules
s2.body: Each module can be switched on or off. Tours for new modules appear in Getting started.

s3.title: Hide for yourself
s3.body: Members can hide a module just for themselves.

s1.title: Invite someone
s1.body: Invite by email or share a link. Verify your email first.

s1.title: Team activity
s1.body: See what the team worked on and who is online.

s2.title: Team members
s2.body: Open a member to see their tasks and time.

s1.title: Workspaces
s1.body: Keep work and personal tasks apart. Each workspace has its own board and modules.
s1.mobileBody: Open the menu to keep work and personal tasks in separate workspaces.

s1.title: Theme
s1.body: Light, dark or system, and an accent colour.

s1.title: Notifications
s1.body: Mentions, assignments and agent updates land here.
s1.mobileBody: Tap the bell in the top bar.

s1.title: Usage data
s1.body: Share usage data that is not linked to your account, or not. Switch it off any time.

s2.title: Tips
s2.body: Turn automatic tips off, or reset all tours.

s1.title: Link Telegram
s1.body: Link Telegram. Send text or voice to create a routine draft, and get notifications.

s1.title: Start page
s1.body: Open TMGR on List, Board, Dashboard or Routines.

gettingStarted.title: Getting started
gettingStarted.subtitle: Short guided tours. Do them in any order, skip any of them.

welcomeSetup.title: How do you want to start?
welcomeSetup.subtitle: You can do both later. Nothing here is permanent.

human.title: Just track my tasks
human.description: Tasks, a board and a timer. Ready in a minute.

agent.description: For Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or any MCP client.

welcomeSetup.saveFailed: Could not save your choice. Try again.

connectAgent.pick: Pick the tool you use. TMGR gives it a token and your agent starts picking up tasks.
connectAgent.mobileHint: Open this page on your computer, or copy the command to send it there.
